description.value: One Mile Lake Park is a nature reserve on the outskirts of Pemberton, also known by its Lil'wat name Snent'. Situated along the Sea to Sky Highway, it offers a natural lakeside setting that makes it a appealing rest stop for cyclists traveling through the Pemberton Valley. The park is managed by the Village of Pemberton and is noted as wheelchair accessible.

address.value: 7262 Sea to Sky Highway, Pemberton, V0N 2L1
